analyst.summary: Page Industries (the exclusive Jockey and Speedo licensee in India) remains one of the most capital-efficient consumer businesses in the market, with return on capital employed near 64% and a durable brand moat, but revenue growth has genuinely stalled to mid-single digits as the core innerwear/athleisure franchise matures and competition intensifies. New Gulf-market entries offer a potential growth lever, but at roughly 57x earnings the stock already commands a full quality premium with limited room for disappointment. We rate this a Hold.
